correctness.rationale: Exact free-cycle sign correlation is P(last zero before starting age), using independently verified Beta(mu,1-mu); stationary equilibrium renewal decomposition accounts for residual censoring and independent post-reset sign. H_t derivative is strictly increasing, giving all-lag Jensen inequality. The finite-mass identity follows by Tonelli on a triangle; occupation-variance normalization includes factor 1/2. Potter bounds and the evaluated Beta integral yield Pareto constants, including beta=2 log. The packaged checker passed 12 Poisson reductions, 350 mixture inequalities, 20 heavy-tail comparisons, 6 exact mass checks and 6 Beta identities. Analytical proof, not numerics, controls infinite scope.

value.rationale: Sign is a natural one-bit observable for subdiffusing particles. The theorem gives a unique experimentally controllable all-lag fixed-mean optimal clock and sharp temporal memory/occupation fluctuation laws with exact coefficients, distinguishing periodic, Poisson, and heavy-tailed restart timing. This fills a precise measurement and reset-protocol design gap not explained by known first-passage or stationary-position formulas.
